trace.name: lineage.chain
trace.cypher: MATCH (s:Solution {id:$id}) OPTIONAL MATCH up = (s)-[:BUILDS_ON|SUPERSEDES*1..6]->(anc:Solution) WITH s, collect(up) AS ups OPTIONAL MATCH down = (desc:Solution)-[:BUILDS_ON|SUPERSEDES*1..6]->(s) WITH s, ups, collect(down) AS downs UNWIND (ups + downs + [null]) AS p WITH s, p WHERE p IS NOT NULL UNWIND relationships(p) AS r WITH DISTINCT startNode(r) AS a, endNode(r) AS b, type(r) AS rel RETURN a.id AS from_id, b.id AS to_id, rel

trace.name: lineage.nodes
trace.cypher: UNWIND $ids AS i MATCH (s:Solution {id:i})<-[:PRODUCED]-(se:Session)<-[:RAN]-(d:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (se)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(p:Project) RETURN s.id AS id, s.title AS title, s.status AS status, s.created_at AS created_at, d.name AS dev, t.name AS team, p.name AS project
